VP SARA DUTERTE’S ACHIEVEMENTS AS VICE PRESIDENT 

A growing narrative pushed by kakampinks, NPA fronts, enablers, and Marcos apologists claims that Sara Duterte has accomplished nothing as Vice President. This claim is false.

Despite repeated budget cuts and sustained harassment against OVP personnel, the Office of the Vice President of the Philippines has continued to implement and expand programs launched since 2022. 

These programs directly address transportation, livelihood, education, health, disaster relief, and food security—delivering measurable results nationwide.

Below is a clear breakdown of key programs and outcomes as of July 2025:

Mag Negosyo Ta ’Day

Livelihood Assistance
 • 30 groups assisted
 • 1,416 individuals assisted
 • Total beneficiaries: 1,446

Value for Money
 • Average grant per group: ₱150,000
 • Average grant per individual: ₱15,000
 • Total program cost: ₱36,434,000*

Medical and Burial Assistance (Individuals Assisted)

Medical
 • 2022: 15,417
 • 2023: 95,756
 • 2024: 154,406
 • Total: 265,579

Burial
 • 2022: 4,998
 • 2023: 24,368
 • 2024: 32,891
 • Total: 62,257

Value for Money
 • Total individuals assisted: 327,836
 • Average assistance per individual: ₱6,128
 • Total program cost: ₱2,032,957,000*

PagbaBAGo: A Million Learners and Trees Campaign

School Bags Distributed
 • 2022: 3,820
 • 2023: 156,495
 • 2024: 227,958
 • 2025: 15,547
 • Total: 403,820

Trees Planted
 • 2023: 451,104
 • 2024: 182,982
 • 2025: 308,338
 • Total: 942,424

Value for Money
 • Total program cost: ₱141,244,000
 • Average cost per learner: ₱349.77

Libreng Sakay Program

Passengers Served
 • 2022: 238,743
 • 2023: 638,625
 • 2024: 1,025,275

Value for Money
 • Average cost per passenger: ₱14.33
 • Total program cost: ₱34,627,000*

RIICE (Relief for Indigents and Individuals in Crisis and Emergencies)

Families Served
 • 2022: 694
 • 2023: 11,240
 • 2024: 144,808
 • 2025: 40,479
 • Total: 197,221

Kalusugan Food Truck

First Responders Served
 • 2023: 3,311
 • 2024: 2,055
 • 2025: 1,230
 • Total: 6,596

So, those who are saying that VP Sara has done nothing as Vice President is either uninformed or simply dumb.

-Tio Moreno
